The app · Parenting log × cozy game

A cozy game that keeps your child's records

In minimama, your parenting records slowly grow a 3D room. Photos, voices, the picture books you read and first words all end up in the room where Mama and her baby live.

  • Your baby log brings Mama to lifeMama takes care of the baby in the room. Link the PiyoLog app, and minimama reads yesterday's records (milk, pee, poop, sleep). Mama then does the same care at the same times.
  • Play by touching the roomThe window changes the time of day, the cassette records voices, the lamp turns on the light, and Mama gives care. Mama and the baby react when you touch them.
  • A tree that grows from first wordsRecord a first word like "mamma", "papa" or "love you". It becomes a petal-shaped card on the word tree, and you can keep the voice with it.
  • Focus time turns into knittingWhile the focus timer runs, Mama knits plush toys and blankets in the room. Time spent on chores or work slowly turns into a cuter room.
  • Month-by-month photo booksJust pick photos. The child's age in months and the date are added from the day each photo was taken. Finished books go on the bookshelf, so you can look back as your child grows.

Made with Tripo

Every character was built with Tripo

Mama, the baby girl, the baby boy and the plush toys were all generated, rigged and exported in Tripo Studio. Tripo's rig also carries Mama's own animations, like sitting down and picking up the baby.

Green steps happen in Tripo Studio.

Coming soon · how we'll get there

The baby in the room should be her baby. It should have her child's hairstyle, hair color, skin tone and face, in minimama's own art style.

We don't want a photorealistic copy. We want a little one that parents recognize at a glance, and that strangers can't identify. Our current 3D baby girl already started from a photo: we restyled the image to match Mama, then built the model in Tripo. The hard part, and the part we want to solve, is keeping the child's likeness all the way through to a rigged 3D model.

Step 1 · Spring 2027 · at launch

Avatar parts

One shared baby body with swappable hairstyles and accessories. Face features and colors come next. No photo is needed, and if one is used, it never leaves the phone.

Step 2 · Late 2027 (target) · with Tripo

Photo to 3D head

An optional premium feature: Tripo turns a photo into only the head, in our art style, and attaches it to the shared body. The baby can still crawl, sit, drink milk and sleep.

Step 3 · 2028 · worldwide

For moms everywhere

We'll launch in Japan first, then in English. We'll add hair types and skin tones so that every mom can find her own child.

How Tripo could help

Where we're stuck, and what would unblock it

Style-consistent head generation

Generate only the head, and make the eyes match the game style, with eyelids for blinking and a clean join at the neck. We would love help from Tripo's model-tuning and API teams here.

Generation cost for each family

Every family creates their own child, so each one needs at least one generation. We need generation compute and a server path that keep this affordable for moms.

Hair types and skin tones for the world

Moms around the world need many hairstyles and skin tones. With Tripo, we can build a much wider set of parts.

Reaching moms worldwide

We'd love promotion through Tripo's channels, and help turning Mama, the baby and the plush toys into real merchandise.
